content: परि(री)धानम् .²1 Putting on a garment, dressing. .²2 A garment, especially an under-garment, clothes in general; आत्तचित्रपरिधानविभूषाः <ls>Ki. 9. 1</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 61</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">4. 68</ls>; <ls>Pt. 5. 23</ls> (<ab>fig.</ab>). A sword-sheath; समुल्लसत्तनुपरिधानसंपदः (सदसिलताः) <ls>Śi. 17. 25</ls>. .²3 Closing or concluding. .²4 <ab>Ved.</ab> Putting round.
